title: 110 Surfer Lane | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Spacious Deck With Built-In Grill - 110 Surfer Lane by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 110 Surfer Lane by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 110 Surfer Lane Details: Look no further—your dream beach vacation awaits at 110 Surfer Lane! Nestled in the highly sought-after Seacrest Beach community, perfectly positioned between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach along the iconic Scenic Highway 30A, this stunning home offers the best of coastal living. Set on a quiet, picturesque street, this three-story retreat features 5 bedrooms, 5 full baths, and 2 half baths, along with elegant details throughout—soaring ceilings, custom cabinetry, designer tile and wood floors, and high-end coastal chic finishes. Enjoy the Florida sunshine on one of the many spacious outdoor spaces, ideal for morning coffee or alfresco breakfasts before a day at the beach. In the evening, gather for a sunset dinner on the expansive third-floor deck, complete with a large dining area perfect for grilling and entertaining. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 0.4 Miles (5 minute walk) -Access to The Lagoon Pool at Seacrest Beach (3-Minute Bike Ride) -Parking Spaces: 2 -Dining Accommodations: Table for 10 and Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Large Outdoor Dining Deck with Built-in Gas Grill and Seating for 8 -Game Room with Wet Bar -Access to Seacrest Tram Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Beds / 5 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Bunk Room): Full/Full Restoration Hardware Bunks with Private Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Room / Living Area -Half Bath Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) and Private Balcony -Bedroom 3 (En Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) and Private Balcony -Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunks with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Bedroom 5: (En Suite) King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Large Outdoor Deck -Game Room with Wet Bar -Half Bath Amenities Included: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Rental Golf Carts are not allowed in the Secrest beach Community. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
